title: The deployed-environment acceptance smoke test is never run by any workflow
description:
conversation/bin/acceptance.ts is a real nine-check black-box smoke test (src/acceptance/smoke-test.ts:17-27: session exchange, bot, channel, post, steer, SSE turn.completed, reload order, persistence), gated only by --environment and CHATTICUS_<ENV>_BASE_URL. No deploy workflow and not ci.yml calls it, so nothing automated proves CloudFront, the Lambda front door, SQS and Cognito are wired after a deploy.

Fix: add a post-deploy job to deploy-thinturn-development.yml (and the control-plane development deploy) that runs npx tsx bin/acceptance.ts --environment development under the integration-test principal, and a job on the staging deploys that gates promotion. Extend infra/test/deploy-workflows.test.ts to assert the job exists. Staging's integration test principal is not wired yet (chatticus-99cae9), so the staging job may need to be allowed to skip with a clear message until that lands.
